keyword: how to build a silver stacking portfolio from scratch
angle: A step-by-step beginner framework for building a physical silver portfolio, grounded in current supply-deficit fundamentals and retail investor data showing sustained demand.

stats.claim: Global silver industrial demand reached a new record high for the fourth consecutive year in 2024, driven by green energy infrastructure, vehicle electrification, photovoltaic applications, and AI-related electronics.
stats.source_name: Silver Institute / GlobeNewswire (World Silver Survey 2025), April 2025

stats.claim: The global silver market recorded a structural supply deficit in 2024, the fourth consecutive annual deficit, with cumulative shortfall from 2021-2024 equivalent to 10 months of total global mine supply.
stats.value: 148.9 million ounce deficit in 2024; cumulative 2021-2024 deficit of 678 million ounces
stats.source_name: Silver Institute / GlobeNewswire (World Silver Survey 2025), April 2025

stats.claim: US retail investors have been consistent large-scale buyers of physical silver, accumulating a combined total since 2010.
stats.value: 1.5 billion ounces of physical silver purchased by US retail investors between 2010 and 2024

stats.claim: Silver-backed exchange-traded product (ETP) holdings surged in 2025 as investor demand returned strongly after two years of outflows.
stats.value: ETP holdings up approximately 18% year-to-date through November 6, 2025, generating inflows of 187 million ounces

stats.claim: Silver outperformed both gold and Bitcoin on a year-to-date basis in 2025, reinforcing its case as a portfolio allocation asset.
stats.value: Silver +34% YTD vs gold +28% and Bitcoin +18% as of mid-2025

stats.claim: Global physical silver coin and bar investment demand declined in 2024 to a five-year low, primarily due to a 46% drop in US coin demand, while India surged 21% — illustrating that entry timing and product mix matter for new stackers.
stats.value: 190.9 million ounces in 2024, a 22% decline and five-year low
stats.source_name: Silver Institute / GlobeNewswire (World Silver Survey 2025), April 2025
